feedback.description: this memory records a correction somebody gave, and who gave it

memory.description: a mark on the entity holding one thing a person said about how they want something built or handled, in their own words: a session entry, a comment, a doc. The words are that entity's own text (a doc's body, an entry's content) and are never edited; memory_save makes a doc to hold them only where the graph does not hold them yet. These properties record where the words belong and what is needed to read them, and at, by and via who marked them and when. Who said them, and when, is the entity's created{at, by}

space.description: whose space they were said in — every member of that space can read them, and they are deleted with it

about.description: the app they were said about, by slug, when they were about one

context.description: the line or two needed to understand the words — what was being talked about, never a restatement of what was said

via.description: what they were marked through: a session, a client

belief.description: what a builder concluded from memories: one point a person made, or everything they said about one subject. Its doc says it; its built names the build that made it, and its cites edges what it was built from. Never edited by hand: a wrong belief is fixed in the builder that made it

scope.description: the project it holds for; absent for a principle that holds everywhere

about.description: its subject: a topic, a project, a package, a component (_comp) or a design

memory_save.title: Save a memory
memory_save.description: Save verbatim words or mark their existing entity with on. said with feedback marks the earliest matching words that person wrote; otherwise absent words get a new doc. id patches a memory; omitted fields stay unchanged. Replacing a standalone memory's words requires was from memory_recall's $was.doc.body; marked comments and entries retain their text. feedback records the correcting person. Returns applied bundles.

said.description: the words the person used, as they used them

on.description: the entity already holding the words, to mark instead of copying them: a session entry, a comment, a doc; said, if passed too, must be in its text

title.description: the index line a recall shows first, for a new memory; a mark leaves the entity's own text alone

context.description: what was being discussed, in two lines; never a restatement of what was said

scope.description: project id or name; omit on creation for a memory that applies everywhere, or on a patch to keep the current scope

feedback.description: the correcting person’s id or name, or an empty string if unknown; either marks the memory as feedback

about.description: the app the words were said about, by slug

id.description: existing memory’s id or registered name to patch; omit to create a memory

was.description: the string at $was.doc.body on the memory returned by memory_recall; required when replacing existing words

memory_recall.title: Recall memories
memory_recall.description: Return whole memories with context and $was.doc.body for memory_save.was. said ranks by meaning with vectors, otherwise matches all words newest first. near ranks by the named entity's meaning; said then filters text. Without either, returns newest. ids, scope and feedback narrow results.

said.description: what the memory is about, in a few words: ranked by meaning where this server has a vector index, otherwise matched as text terms the memory must all contain

near.description: entity id or name whose meaning ranks the results, when this server has a vector index; said then selects by its words

scope.description: project id or registered name; return only memories filed under it

feedback.description: only memories recording a correction somebody gave

memory_source.title: Where somebody said these words
memory_source.description: Find the earliest entity the named person wrote containing these words verbatim. Other authors' quotes do not count. Returns whole bundles; refuses when no source exists. Use its id with memory_save.on.

said.description: the words, exactly as they were written; line breaks and runs of spaces do not count

by.description: who said them: their id or registered name

memory_around.title: Read the transcript around an entry
memory_around.description: Return whole transcript entries around an entry, in order, including tool calls and results. before and after count entries. Refuses a non-entry id.

id.description: the memory, or any entity, to read around: its id or registered name

before.description: how many entries ahead of it (default 3)

memory_target.title: What an entity is aimed at
memory_target.description: Read whole entities named by its components' target fields; for a comment, what it comments on. Refuses an entity with no target.

id.description: the memory, or any entity, to read around: its id or registered name

memory_thread.title: Read the discussion an entity is in
memory_thread.description: Return the root target and all its comments and replies as whole bundles, oldest first. A target without comments answers alone.

id.description: the memory, or any entity, to read around: its id or registered name

memory_session.title: Where something happened
memory_session.description: Return the session that wrote an entity, then its worked-on or claimed tasks, as whole bundles. Refuses an entity with no session.

id.description: the memory, or any entity, to read around: its id or registered name
